text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy for a change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa-ho-ho-ho-ho!!
A loud voice suddenly rang out!
Startled, I look around to see...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You have done well to pass through, traveler.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am the guardian of this realm.
The one who lurks within the trees.

Gold Ship suddenly bursts out from inside the tree.
Just how long had she been in there...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: By the way, traveler, let me ask you one thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Didst thou drop into the tree...
a heavy, heavy fake food sample made of steel?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Or is it a super-duper-fast
7G-compatible hyper phone?"

I checked around me,
but there's no sign that I dropped anything in particular...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho? You didn't drop anything?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? You didn't drop anything?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Read the room, damn it!! Even if you have to force it, match the energy!!

No matter how much I resist, I have no choice
but to match the mood. In that case...
choice_data_list: It's a food replica made of steel.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho.
Well answered, traveler.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"To you, the honest soul, I shall bestow
a replica food sample made of steel. Pray, wait a moment."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Nghhhhhh...!!!!

A low groaning sound echoes from inside the tree...
It sounds pretty heavy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, was this always this heavy...?
Nghhh, grrgh——ah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap, the spiky part got caught!
The spiky part of the steel fried prawn...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I thought I heard a voice...
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ryan!
Perfect timing, gimme a hand here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Phew~ That was a close one. I almost left the Steel Fried Shrimp stuck in that tree forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
I'm just glad I could help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
However, if you're going to carry something that heavy,
you need to train properly on a regular basis.
It'd be all for nothing if you injured yourself—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know!
Want to do some muscle training together right now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think I can give you advice
on what parts to train to prevent injury!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(Oh crap! When Ryan talks about muscle training,
she means a boot camp from hell...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No, my muscles just aren't really feeling it today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I'll support you all the way!
Come on, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: W-Waaaaaaaaah~~~~……!!
Overwhelmed by Mejiro Ryan's momentum, Gold Ship headed toward the gym—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nice, those glutes are bouncing!
Let's keep the rhythm going for 50 reps!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Grrr...!! Rhyth, mical...!!

After her workout, Gold Ship looked
buffier than usual...
and... just a little bit tired.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho.
Well answered, traveler.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"To you, the honest soul, I shall bestow
a blazing-fast 7G-compatible smartphone! Here it comes—!"
Gold Ship raised her smartphone overhead, and then—
(*swoosh――*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho. Fast, isn't it?
After all, 7G = the underwater speed of 7 spotted seals.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come now, if you don't chase after it quickly,
your smartphone will fall to the ground.
I just have to run and get it back...!—Just as I thought that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uhyoooh!? A smartphone that smells like an Umamusume is flying through the airrr!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh crap!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that's my smartphone!!
Trainer, we're going all out!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Who knows what'll happen if she's the one who picks me up?!
With a look of sheer desperation, Gold Ship began chasing after the smartphone...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
OOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: MY PHOOOOONE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeh~?! I'm being chased by an Umamusume~~~?!?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I safely got my smartphone back...
And learned a valuable lesson in the process.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe...! I was chased by an Umamusume...!
This is the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"There are some crazy folks out there in the world.
So don't ever, EVER throw your smartphone."
